value.rationale: The update separates the three failure boundaries without changing statutes or native scoring. The new payment contract covers payment existence and roles, means and service purpose, exact payment time, and actual plan ontology; wages never imply cash, and service dates never become payment dates. The service contract retains both purpose_ and type_ ports and exact service start/end observations. Host partitions preserve shared source keys while allowing payment facts, nullable means, plan scans, and service endpoints to complete independently.
